notes: Eclipse Loop 1.5.2 - loop-framing polish. TRIM now cuts silence AND snaps the result to a whole number of bars at the project tempo, so a trimmed loop still loops perfectly in time instead of drifting off the grid. Under the hood, the loop transforms that are easy to get subtly wrong (stutter, trim, length handling) were moved into a pure, self-tested module and the app now runs a headless test suite on every build that asserts the loop stays a perfect, correctly-framed loop after these edits. Still 4 synths (Prism, Alloy, Dusk, Vibe) + 25 FX bundled, universal (Apple Silicon + Intel), macOS 12+.
